slug.description: The name a client addresses this camera by.

width.description: Frame width in pixels, as the published configuration declares it.

height.description: Frame height in pixels, as the published configuration declares it.

fps.description: How many frames per second the camera is configured to publish while somebody is watching live.

snapshot_interval_seconds.description: How often a still frame is captured for the cheap snapshot reads, in seconds, between `1` and `3600`. Independent of `fps`, which is about live video.
